// FIXTURE — Swift-shaped source containing a Todoist endpoint that is NOT on
// scripts/todoist-allowed-endpoints.txt. scripts/tests/run-script-tests.sh
// copies this into a temporary directory as a .swift file and runs
// check-todoist-writes.sh against it, expecting a non-zero exit.
//
// A hook that has never been shown to FAIL is not known to work, and this one
// guards a non-negotiable: the only write this app may make to Todoist is
// completing a task.
//
// This is a fixture, not compiled code. It lives outside the app's source glob
// and is never part of any target.

// Commenting on a task. Explicitly forbidden by CLAUDE.md.
let commentsURL = "https://api.todoist.com/api/v1/comments"

// Moving a task is an UPDATE. Also forbidden, and listed second so the check
// is shown to report every violation rather than stopping at the first.
let moveURL = "https://api.todoist.com/api/v1/tasks/\(taskID)/move"
